  select source_database, collected_at, inst_id, sql_id,
    coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0) as plan_hash_value,
    sum(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) as elapsed_time_micro,
    sum(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) as cpu_time_micro,
    sum(coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0)) as user_io_wait_micro,
    sum(coalesce(executions, 0)) as executions,
    sum(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) as buffer_gets,
    sum(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) as disk_reads,
    sum(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) as rows_processed
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database, collected_at, inst_id, sql_id,
    coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0)
), ordered as (
  select *,
    lag(elapsed_time_micro) over w as prev_elapsed,
    lag(cpu_time_micro) over w as prev_cpu,
    lag(user_io_wait_micro) over w as prev_user_io,
    lag(executions) over w as prev_executions,
    lag(buffer_gets) over w as prev_buffer_gets,
    lag(disk_reads) over w as prev_disk_reads,
    lag(rows_processed) over w as prev_rows_processed
  from samples
  window w as (
    partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, plan_hash_value
    order by collected_at
  )
), deltas as (
  select source_database, inst_id, sql_id, plan_hash_value,
    case when prev_elapsed is null or elapsed_time_micro < prev_elapsed then 0 else elapsed_time_micro - prev_elapsed end as elapsed_micro_delta,
    case when prev_cpu is null or cpu_time_micro < prev_cpu then 0 else cpu_time_micro - prev_cpu end as cpu_micro_delta,
    case when prev_user_io is null or user_io_wait_micro < prev_user_io then 0 else user_io_wait_micro - prev_user_io end as user_io_micro_delta,
    case when prev_executions is null or executions < prev_executions then 0 else executions - prev_executions end as executions_delta,
    case when prev_buffer_gets is null or buffer_gets < prev_buffer_gets then 0 else buffer_gets - prev_buffer_gets end as buffer_gets_delta,
    case when prev_disk_reads is null or disk_reads < prev_disk_reads then 0 else disk_reads - prev_disk_reads end as disk_reads_delta,
    case when prev_rows_processed is null or rows_processed < prev_rows_processed then 0 else rows_processed - prev_rows_processed end as rows_processed_delta
  from ordered
), totals as (
  select source_database, inst_id, sql_id, plan_hash_value,
    sum(elapsed_micro_delta) as elapsed_micro_delta,
    sum(cpu_micro_delta) as cpu_micro_delta,
    sum(user_io_micro_delta) as user_io_micro_delta,
    sum(executions_delta) as executions_delta,
    sum(buffer_gets_delta) as buffer_gets_delta,
    sum(disk_reads_delta) as disk_reads_delta,
    sum(rows_processed_delta) as rows_processed_delta
  from deltas
  group by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, plan_hash_value
)
select
  inst_id,
  sql_id,
  cast(null as bigint) as child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  round(elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as elapsed_seconds_delta,
  round(cpu_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as cpu_seconds_delta,
  round(user_io_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as user_io_seconds_delta,
  executions_delta,
  buffer_gets_delta,
  disk_reads_delta,
  left((select t.sql_fulltext from oracle_sql_texts t where t.source_database = totals.source_database and t.sql_id = totals.sql_id), 240) as sql_preview
from totals
where elapsed_micro_delta > 0
order by elapsed_micro_delta desc
limit 50;
